title: A も ～ば B も ～ — both A and B
summary: Lists two matters with も … ば … も, as in 'both … and ….' The ば-form is used to line up two good points, two bad points, or opposites.

patterns.gloss: N も + ば-form + N も
N も あれば、N も ある

body.p: The first half is も + ば-form, the second も + predicate. It lists items of the same kind, as in パンもあれば飲み物もある, or opposites, as in いい日もあれば悪い日もある.
Adding ば to plain も～も gives a softer, descriptive feel. It resembles AだしBも, but も～ば～も lists things within the same category.

examples.ja: 彼（かれ）は頭（あたま）もよければ、性格（せいかく）もいい。
examples.romaji: Kare wa atama mo yokereba, seikaku mo ii.
examples.tr: He is both smart and has a good personality.

examples.ja: この店（みせ）には、パンもあれば飲（の）み物（もの）もある。
examples.romaji: Kono mise ni wa, pan mo areba nomimono mo aru.
examples.tr: This shop has both bread and drinks.

examples.ja: 人生（じんせい）には、いい日（ひ）もあれば悪（わる）い日（ひ）もある。
examples.romaji: Jinsei ni wa, ii hi mo areba warui hi mo aru.
examples.tr: In life there are both good days and bad days.

pitfalls: Do not drop either も: パンあれば飲み物もある is unnatural.
Mind the ば-form: い-adjective よければ, verb あれば.
